_comment: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_chest (ändrad 1 nov 2026) - 1 % chans för en unique per 8 676 poäng, tak 65,7 %
(570 000 poäng). Vikter normal (summa 60): prayer scrolls 14 vardera, buckler 4, DHCB 4, Dinh's 3, ancestral 4 per del,
claws 3, elder maul 2, kodai 2, twisted bow 2. Challenge Mode (summa 56): samma men scrolls 12. Ändrat 12 aug 2026
(tidigare 69/69). Wikins exempel 26 025 poäng per raid används för ungefärliga rates: chans för en unique ≈ 3 %,
rate = 1 / (0,03 × vikt/60). https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Chambers_of_Xeric - inga quest- eller skillkrav.
Item-id från gameval: 21034 RAIDS_PRAYERSCROLL (Dexterous), 21079 RAIDS_PRAYERSCROLL_AUGURY (Arcane), 21000 TWISTED_BUCKLER,
21043 KODAI_INSIGNIA, 20997 TWISTED_BOW. KC-målen är 1 completion; användaren kan höja dem.
name: Chambers of Xeric
description: Raid completions in both modes and every unique from the Ancient chest

root.title: Chambers of Xeric
root.note: There are no quest or skill requirements to enter.

children.note: Your first completion. Raise the count to set your own target.

dropSource.approximateNote: Depends on points: about 3% for a unique with 26,025 personal points per raid (the wiki's example). More points give a better chance.

children.note: Reading the scroll uses it up, so a scroll you have already read is not counted. 14/60 of uniques (12/56 in Challenge Mode).
